items.markdown:
![The Marketing Research Process | Introduction to Business](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081818-2633-0066-0000-272600de4af5:4)
Marketing research is `the systematic gathering, recording, and analysis of qualitative and quantitative data about customers, competitors, and market trends to reduce business uncertainty`.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marketing_research)[[2]](https://www.qualtrics.com/articles/strategy-research/market-research-guide/)

### Core Types of Research

- **Primary Research:** Original data collected firsthand through surveys, focus groups, interviews, or observations.[[1]](https://www.surveymonkey.com/learn/market-research/marketing-research-process-guide/)[[2]](https://study.com/academy/lesson/video/market-research-definition-analysis-methodology.html)
- **Secondary Research:** Existing data mined from industry reports, public databases, literature reviews, or case studies.[[1]](https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/how-to-conduct-market-research/)[[2]](https://study.com/academy/lesson/video/market-research-definition-analysis-methodology.html)
- **Qualitative Research:** Open-ended insights exploring human motivations, emotions, and underlying "whys".[[1]](https://www.qualtrics.com/articles/strategy-research/market-research-guide/)
- **Quantitative Research:** Structured, numerical data used to measure trends, market sizes, and statistical patterns.

### Key Methods

- **Surveys and Questionnaires:** Online or point-of-sale forms gathering scale-based and open-ended feedback.[[1]](https://www.questionpro.com/blog/marketing-research/)
- **Focus Groups and Interviews:** Direct conversations with selected consumer segments to test concepts.[[1]](https://libguides.ecu.edu/market_research)
- **Observation:** Watching how customers interact with products or services in real-world environments.
- **Data Mining and Analytics:** Evaluating sales metrics, social media sentiment, and competitor performance.[[1]](https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/how-to-conduct-market-research/)[[2]](https://libguides.ecu.edu/market_research)

### The 6-Step Research Process

1. **Define the Problem:** Clearly identify the specific business question or revenue challenge.
2. **Set Objectives:** Determine whether goals are exploratory, descriptive, or causal.
3. **Design the Plan:** Choose primary or secondary methods and build a timeline via platforms like [SurveyMonkey](https://www.surveymonkey.com/learn/market-research/marketing-research-process-guide/).
4. **Collect Data:** Deploy instruments and gather raw information from your target population.
5. **Analyze Data:** Process and interpret the findings to uncover actionable patterns.
6. **Implement Findings:** Forward insights to decision-makers to shape product, pricing, or campaign strategies.[[1]](https://www.hanoverresearch.com/insights-blog/corporate/what-is-market-research/)[[2]](https://study.com/academy/lesson/video/market-research-definition-analysis-methodology.html)[[3]](https://www.surveymonkey.com/learn/market-research/marketing-research-process-guide/)[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marketing_research)

If you are planning a research project, let me know:

- What **specific question** or problem you need to solve
- Your **target audience** or industry
- Whether you have a **budget** for tools or external agencies

I can help you build a step-by-step research plan.
